import json, shutil, pathlib
path = pathlib.Path(r"C:\HeavenServices\services.json")
backup = pathlib.Path(r"C:\HeavenServices\backups\services.pre-worker-fabric-repair-20260929.json")
if not backup.exists():
    raise SystemExit("backup missing")
with backup.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

def collect_named(obj, out):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        if isinstance(obj.get("name"), str) and obj["name"]:
            out.append(obj)
            return
        if "value" in obj:
            collect_named(obj["value"], out)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for x in obj:
            collect_named(x, out)

items=[]
collect_named(data, items)
items=[x for x in items if x.get("name") != "Heaven Worker Fabric"]
entry={
    "name":"Heaven Worker Fabric",
    "category":"isolated local workers",
    "version":"heaven/worker-node22:2026.09",
    "install_method":"Docker Compose in Ubuntu WSL2",
    "executable_container":"heaven-worker-01..08",
    "URL":"",
    "host":"Docker bridge only",
    "port":0,
    "healthcheck":"Docker healthcheck: Node + Python + Git",
    "startup_mechanism":"base 01-04: Docker restart unless-stopped; burst 05-08: opt-in",
    "data_path":r"Docker named volumes; C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\shared; C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\artifacts",
    "config_path":r"C:\HeavenServices\worker-fabric\docker-compose.yml",
    "update_command":r"powershell -File C:\HeavenServices\scripts\heaven-workers.ps1 BUILD",
    "enabled":True,
    "notes":"4 healthy base workers at 4 CPU/2 GiB each; 4 verified burst workers at 2 CPU/1 GiB each; no published ports; no host credential mounts"
}
items.append(entry)
if len(items) != 21:
    raise SystemExit(f"expected 21 entries after recovery, got {len(items)}: {[x.get('name') for x in items]}")
if len([x for x in items if x.get("name")=="Heaven Worker Fabric"]) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("worker fabric multiplicity invalid")
if any(not x.get("name") for x in items):
    raise SystemExit("unnamed entries remain")
snapshot = pathlib.Path(r"C:\HeavenServices\backups\services.pre-python-repair-20260929.json")
shutil.copy2(path, snapshot)
tmp = path.with_suffix(".json.tmp")
with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="\n") as f:
    json.dump(items, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=4)
    f.write("\n")
tmp.replace(path)
with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    check=json.load(f)
assert isinstance(check,list) and len(check)==21
assert sum(1 for x in check if x.get("name")=="Heaven Worker Fabric")==1
print(json.dumps({
    "count":len(check),
    "first":check[0]["name"],
    "last":check[-1]["name"],
    "worker_fabric_count":sum(1 for x in check if x.get("name")=="Heaven Worker Fabric"),
    "all_named":all(bool(x.get("name")) for x in check),
    "backup_used":str(backup)
}, separators=(",",":")))
